tools.name: inspect
tools.title: Inspect
tools.description: Read-only inspection of the current Blockbench project. `target` selects which slice of state to return; remaining fields are per-target filters. Replaces 28 legacy read tools (list_*/get_*/find_*/filter_*). See docs for the full target list. Returns structured JSON wrapped in { ok, data, meta }.

target.description: Which slice of Blockbench state to read. Each target accepts a subset of the optional filters below; unrelated filters are ignored.
target.markdownDescription: Which slice of Blockbench state to read. Each target accepts a subset of the optional filters below; unrelated filters are ignored.

tools.name: aj_variant_op
tools.title: AJ: Variant Op
tools.description: Animated Java variant operations (create/duplicate/update/delete/apply) collapsed into a single tool. Specify `action` plus the relevant fields. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy aj_variant_create / aj_variant_duplicate / aj_variant_update / aj_variant_delete / aj_variant_apply.

action.description: Operation to perform. create: new empty variant. duplicate: copy an existing variant. update: rename. delete: remove. apply: select for the preview viewport.
action.markdownDescription: Operation to perform. create: new empty variant. duplicate: copy an existing variant. update: rename. delete: remove. apply: select for the preview viewport.

variant.description: Target variant for duplicate/update/delete/apply. UUID, internal name, or display name.
variant.markdownDescription: Target variant for duplicate/update/delete/apply. UUID, internal name, or display name.

display_name.description: Display name for create/update. Made unique automatically if it collides.
display_name.markdownDescription: Display name for create/update. Made unique automatically if it collides.

tools.name: aj_blueprint_settings_op
tools.title: AJ Blueprint Settings Op
tools.description: Animated Java Blueprint Settings operations (get/set) collapsed into a single tool. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy aj_blueprint_settings_get / aj_blueprint_settings_set. Requires an Animated Java Blueprint project to be open.

action.description: Operation. get: returns all Blueprint Settings as a JSON object. set: updates a single setting by key.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. get: returns all Blueprint Settings as a JSON object. set: updates a single setting by key.

key.description: Blueprint Setting key to update (e.g. `tsb_optimized_export`). Required for set.
key.markdownDescription: Blueprint Setting key to update (e.g. `tsb_optimized_export`). Required for set.

value.description: New value for the setting. Type must match the setting's current type. Required for set.
value.markdownDescription: New value for the setting. Type must match the setting's current type. Required for set.

tools.name: null_object_op
tools.title: Null Object Op
tools.description: Null object operations (create/update/remove) collapsed into a single tool. Null objects act as IK targets in animation_mode formats. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy add_null_object / update_null_object / remove_null_object. Use inspect(target='null_objects') to list.

action.description: Operation. create: new null object (IK target). update: mutate fields by id. remove: delete by id.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create: new null object (IK target). update: mutate fields by id. remove: delete by id.

id.description: Target null object UUID or name. Required for update/remove.
id.markdownDescription: Target null object UUID or name. Required for update/remove.

parent.description: Parent group (name/UUID) for create. Defaults to outliner root.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent group (name/UUID) for create. Defaults to outliner root.

ik_target.description: IK chain end node (Group/Locator/ArmatureBone, by name or UUID). Pass empty string in update to clear.
ik_target.markdownDescription: IK chain end node (Group/Locator/ArmatureBone, by name or UUID). Pass empty string in update to clear.

ik_source.description: IK chain start node. Pass empty string in update to clear.
ik_source.markdownDescription: IK chain start node. Pass empty string in update to clear.

lock_ik_target_rotation.description: Lock the IK target's rotation while solving.
lock_ik_target_rotation.markdownDescription: Lock the IK target's rotation while solving.

tools.name: cube_op
tools.title: Cube Op
tools.description: Cube operations (create/update) collapsed into a single tool. create places one or more new cubes with optional texture+UV; update mutates an existing cube (or all selected cubes when id is omitted). Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy place_cube / modify_cube.

action.description: Operation. create: place one or more cubes (legacy place_cube). update: modify an existing cube (legacy modify_cube).
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create: place one or more cubes (legacy place_cube). update: modify an existing cube (legacy modify_cube).

elements.description: Array of cubes to place. Required for action='create'.
elements.markdownDescription: Array of cubes to place. Required for action='create'.

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply (action='create'). Defaults to project default.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture ID or name to apply (action='create'). Defaults to project default.

faces.description: Face selection for create. true = auto UV, string[] = specific faces, object[] = per-face UV override.
faces.markdownDescription: Face selection for create. true = auto UV, string[] = specific faces, object[] = per-face UV override.

id.description: Cube UUID or name to modify. For action='update'; defaults to selected cubes when omitted.
id.markdownDescription: Cube UUID or name to modify. For action='update'; defaults to selected cubes when omitted.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Returns the image data of the current view.

tools.name: capture_app_screenshot
tools.title: Capture App Screenshot
tools.description: Returns the image data of the Blockbench app.

tools.name: set_camera_angle
tools.title: Set Camera Angle
tools.description: Sets the camera angle to the specified value.

tools.name: create_animation
tools.title: Create Animation
tools.description: Creates a new animation with keyframes for bones.

animation_length.description: Length of the animation in seconds
animation_length.markdownDescription: Length of the animation in seconds

particle_effects.description: Particle effects with timestamps as keys
particle_effects.markdownDescription: Particle effects with timestamps as keys

tools.name: manage_keyframes
tools.title: Manage Keyframes
tools.description: Creates, deletes, or edits keyframes in the animation timeline for specific bones and channels.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

action.description: Action to perform on keyframes.
action.markdownDescription: Action to perform on keyframes.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to manage keyframes for.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Name of the bone/group to manage keyframes for.

time.description: Time in seconds for the keyframe.
time.markdownDescription: Time in seconds for the keyframe.

values.description: Values: [x,y,z] for position/rotation, number for uniform scale.
values.markdownDescription: Values: [x,y,z] for position/rotation, number for uniform scale.

bezier_handles.description: Bezier handle positions for bezier interpolation.
bezier_handles.markdownDescription: Bezier handle positions for bezier interpolation.

tools.name: animation_graph_editor
tools.title: Animation Graph Editor
tools.description: Controls animation curves in the graph editor for fine-tuning animations.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Name of the bone/group to modify curves for.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Name of the bone/group to modify curves for.

action.description: Type of curve modification to apply.
action.markdownDescription: Type of curve modification to apply.

keyframe_range.description: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.
keyframe_range.markdownDescription: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.

custom_curve.description: Custom bezier curve control points (only for 'custom' action).
custom_curve.markdownDescription: Custom bezier curve control points (only for 'custom' action).

tools.name: bone_rigging
tools.title: Bone Rigging
tools.description: Creates and manipulates the bone structure (rig) of a model for animation.

action.description: Action to perform on the bone structure.
action.markdownDescription: Action to perform on the bone structure.

children.description: Names of elements to add to this bone.
children.markdownDescription: Names of elements to add to this bone.

ik_enabled.description: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.
ik_enabled.markdownDescription: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror the bone across.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Axis to mirror the bone across.

tools.name: animation_timeline
tools.title: Animation Timeline
tools.description: Controls the animation timeline, including playback, time scrubbing, and timeline settings.

action.description: Timeline action to perform.
action.markdownDescription: Timeline action to perform.

length.description: Animation length in seconds (for set_length action).
length.markdownDescription: Animation length in seconds (for set_length action).

tools.name: batch_keyframe_operations
tools.title: Batch Keyframe Operations
tools.description: Performs batch operations on multiple keyframes at once.

scale_factor.description: Scale factor for time or values.
scale_factor.markdownDescription: Scale factor for time or values.

tools.name: animation_copy_paste
tools.title: Animation Copy/Paste
tools.description: Copies and pastes animation data between bones or animations.

action.description: Copy or paste action.
action.markdownDescription: Copy or paste action.

time_range.description: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.
time_range.markdownDescription: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror across for mirror_paste.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Axis to mirror across for mirror_paste.

tools.name: armature_op
tools.title: Armature Op
tools.description: Armature operations (create/update/remove) collapsed into a single tool. Armatures are skeletal rigs used for mesh deformation; requires a format with armature_rig support. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy add_armature / update_armature / remove_armature. Use inspect(target='armatures') to list.

action.description: Operation. create: new armature (skeletal rig). update: mutate fields by id. remove: delete armature and its bones.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create: new armature (skeletal rig). update: mutate fields by id. remove: delete armature and its bones.

id.description: Target armature UUID or name. Required for update/remove.
id.markdownDescription: Target armature UUID or name. Required for update/remove.

add_initial_bone.description: Whether to add an initial bone on create. Defaults to true.
add_initial_bone.markdownDescription: Whether to add an initial bone on create. Defaults to true.

export.description: Whether to export this armature (update only).
export.markdownDescription: Whether to export this armature (update only).

tools.name: armature_bone_op
tools.title: Armature Bone Op
tools.description: Armature bone operations (create/update/update_batch/remove) collapsed into a single tool. Bones are children of an Armature or another bone. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy add_armature_bone / update_armature_bone / update_armature_bones_batch / remove_armature_bone. Use inspect(target='bones') to list.

action.description: Operation. create: new bone under parent (armature or bone). update: mutate one bone by id. update_batch: apply visibility/locked/color to many bones at once. remove: delete bone.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create: new bone under parent (armature or bone). update: mutate one bone by id. update_batch: apply visibility/locked/color to many bones at once. remove: delete bone.

id.description: Target bone UUID or name. Required for update/remove.
id.markdownDescription: Target bone UUID or name. Required for update/remove.

ids.description: Array of bone UUIDs or names. Required for update_batch.
ids.markdownDescription: Array of bone UUIDs or names. Required for update_batch.

parent_id.description: Parent armature or bone (name/UUID). Required for create.
parent_id.markdownDescription: Parent armature or bone (name/UUID). Required for create.

origin.description: Position [x, y, z]. Defaults to [0, parent.length, 0] for child bones on create.
origin.markdownDescription: Position [x, y, z]. Defaults to [0, parent.length, 0] for child bones on create.

connected.description: Whether bone is connected to parent.
connected.markdownDescription: Whether bone is connected to parent.

remove_children.description: When action=remove, whether to also remove child bones. Default true.
remove_children.markdownDescription: When action=remove, whether to also remove child bones. Default true.

tools.name: vertex_weight_op
tools.title: Vertex Weight Op
tools.description: Vertex weight operations (set/set_batch/clear) collapsed into a single tool. Mesh defaults to the first selected mesh when mesh_id is omitted. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy set_vertex_weight / set_vertex_weights_batch / clear_vertex_weights. Use inspect(target='vertex_weights') to read current weights.

action.description: Operation. set: write one vertex weight. set_batch: write many weights at once. clear: remove all weights of this bone for this mesh.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. set: write one vertex weight. set_batch: write many weights at once. clear: remove all weights of this bone for this mesh.

mesh_id.description: Target mesh UUID or name. Defaults to the first selected mesh.
mesh_id.markdownDescription: Target mesh UUID or name. Defaults to the first selected mesh.

vertex_key.description: Vertex key in the mesh. Required for action='set'.
vertex_key.markdownDescription: Vertex key in the mesh. Required for action='set'.

weight.description: Weight value (0-1, set to 0 to remove). Required for action='set'.
weight.markdownDescription: Weight value (0-1, set to 0 to remove). Required for action='set'.

weights.description: Map of vertex_key -> weight value. Required for action='set_batch'.
weights.markdownDescription: Map of vertex_key -> weight value. Required for action='set_batch'.

tools.name: selection_op
tools.title: Selection Op
tools.description: Selection operations (all_of_type/armature_bones) collapsed into a single tool. all_of_type selects every cube/mesh/group of a given type (optionally scoped to a parent group); armature_bones selects bones by id list or whole armature. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy select_all_of_type / select_armature_bones. Use inspect(target='selection') to read the current selection.

action.description: Selection scope. all_of_type: select every cube/mesh/group of a given type. armature_bones: select bones by id or whole armature.
action.markdownDescription: Selection scope. all_of_type: select every cube/mesh/group of a given type. armature_bones: select bones by id or whole armature.

parent_group.description: Parent group (UUID or name) to scope the selection. For action='all_of_type'.
parent_group.markdownDescription: Parent group (UUID or name) to scope the selection. For action='all_of_type'.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to current selection instead of replacing. For action='all_of_type'.
add_to_selection.markdownDescription: If true, add to current selection instead of replacing. For action='all_of_type'.

items.description: ID or name of the element.
items.markdownDescription: ID or name of the element.

ids.description: Bone UUIDs or names to select. For action='armature_bones'.
ids.markdownDescription: Bone UUIDs or names to select. For action='armature_bones'.

armature_id.description: Select all bones in this armature. For action='armature_bones'.
armature_id.markdownDescription: Select all bones in this armature. For action='armature_bones'.

include_descendants.description: Include descendant bones in selection. For action='armature_bones'.
include_descendants.markdownDescription: Include descendant bones in selection. For action='armature_bones'.

clear_selection.description: Clear existing selection before selecting (default true). For action='armature_bones'.
clear_selection.markdownDescription: Clear existing selection before selecting (default true). For action='armature_bones'.

tools.name: element_op
tools.title: Element Op
tools.description: Element operations (remove/add_group/duplicate/rename) collapsed into a single tool. Replaces legacy remove_element / add_group / duplicate_element / rename_element. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Use inspect(target='outline') to discover element ids.

action.description: Operation. remove: delete element by id. add_group: create a new outliner group. duplicate: copy an element with offset. rename: change an element's name.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. remove: delete element by id. add_group: create a new outliner group. duplicate: copy an element with offset. rename: change an element's name.

id.description: Target element UUID or name. Required for remove/duplicate/rename. Use inspect(target='outline') to discover ids.
id.markdownDescription: Target element UUID or name. Required for remove/duplicate/rename. Use inspect(target='outline') to discover ids.

name.description: Name for add_group (required) or new name for rename (required).
name.markdownDescription: Name for add_group (required) or new name for rename (required).

parent.description: Parent group name/uuid for add_group, or 'root' to attach at the outliner root. Defaults to 'root'.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent group name/uuid for add_group, or 'root' to attach at the outliner root. Defaults to 'root'.

visibility.description: Visibility for add_group. Defaults to true.
visibility.markdownDescription: Visibility for add_group. Defaults to true.

autouv.description: Auto-UV mode for add_group. Defaults to 1.
autouv.markdownDescription: Auto-UV mode for add_group. Defaults to 1.

selected.description: Whether new group is selected after creation. Defaults to false.
selected.markdownDescription: Whether new group is selected after creation. Defaults to false.

shade.description: Shade flag for add_group. Defaults to true.
shade.markdownDescription: Shade flag for add_group. Defaults to true.

offset.description: Position offset for duplicate. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].
offset.markdownDescription: Position offset for duplicate. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].

new_name.description: New name for duplicate (optional) or rename (required as 'name').
new_name.markdownDescription: New name for duplicate (optional) or rename (required as 'name').

tools.name: list_export_formats
tools.title: List Export Formats
tools.description: Lists all registered export codecs with their id, display name, file extension, and whether they support compile/export. Use before `export_model` to pick a codec.

only_current_format.description: If true, only return codecs compatible with the current project's format.
only_current_format.markdownDescription: If true, only return codecs compatible with the current project's format.

tools.name: export_model
tools.title: Export Model
tools.description: Compiles the current project through the named codec and returns the result as text. Optionally writes the compiled content to a filesystem path (requires user permission in Blockbench v5.0+). Use `list_export_formats` first to discover codec IDs.

codec_id.description: Codec ID to use for export (e.g., 'obj', 'gltf', 'project', 'bedrock'). If omitted, uses the current project format's codec. Use `list_export_formats` to see available IDs.
codec_id.markdownDescription: Codec ID to use for export (e.g., 'obj', 'gltf', 'project', 'bedrock'). If omitted, uses the current project format's codec. Use `list_export_formats` to see available IDs.

options.description: Codec-specific export options. Defaults to the codec's configured export options.
options.markdownDescription: Codec-specific export options. Defaults to the codec's configured export options.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to write the compiled model to. Requires user permission (Blockbench v5.0+ prompts for 'fs' access). If omitted, content is returned in the response only.
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to write the compiled model to. Requires user permission (Blockbench v5.0+ prompts for 'fs' access). If omitted, content is returned in the response only.

max_content_length.description: Maximum number of characters to include in the returned `content` field. Use 0 to omit content entirely (useful when only writing to disk). Larger values risk exceeding MCP context limits.
max_content_length.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters to include in the returned `content` field. Use 0 to omit content entirely (useful when only writing to disk). Larger values risk exceeding MCP context limits.

tools.name: history_op
tools.title: History Op
tools.description: Undo history operations (undo/redo/save_checkpoint) collapsed into a single tool. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy undo / redo / save_checkpoint. Inspect the stack with inspect(target='history').

action.description: Operation. undo/redo: traverse the Undo stack. save_checkpoint: insert a named marker. Use inspect(target='history') to list entries.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. undo/redo: traverse the Undo stack. save_checkpoint: insert a named marker. Use inspect(target='history') to list entries.

steps.description: Number of steps for undo/redo. Defaults to 1.
steps.markdownDescription: Number of steps for undo/redo. Defaults to 1.

name.description: Checkpoint name (action='save_checkpoint' only). Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.
name.markdownDescription: Checkpoint name (action='save_checkpoint' only). Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.

tools.name: from_geo_json
tools.title: Import GeoJSON
tools.description: Imports a model from a GeoJSON file.

geojson.description: Path to the GeoJSON file or data URL, or the GeoJSON string itself.
geojson.markdownDescription: Path to the GeoJSON file or data URL, or the GeoJSON string itself.

tools.name: material_instance_op
tools.title: Material Instance Op
tools.description: Material instance operations (set/bulk_set/clear) collapsed into a single tool. Material instances map cube faces to materials defined in the minecraft:material_instances component (Bedrock Block format). Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy set_face_material_instance / bulk_set_material_instances / clear_material_instances. Use inspect(target='material_instances') to list current assignments.

action.description: Operation. set: assign one material instance to faces of one or more cubes. bulk_set: apply many assignments at once. clear: remove material instance names.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. set: assign one material instance to faces of one or more cubes. bulk_set: apply many assignments at once. clear: remove material instance names.

cube_id.description: Cube UUID or name. For set/clear; defaults to all selected cubes when omitted.
cube_id.markdownDescription: Cube UUID or name. For set/clear; defaults to all selected cubes when omitted.

material_name.description: Material instance name. Required for action='set'. Empty string clears.
material_name.markdownDescription: Material instance name. Required for action='set'. Empty string clears.

faces.description: Faces to set/clear. Defaults to all faces.
faces.markdownDescription: Faces to set/clear. Defaults to all faces.

all_cubes.description: When action='clear', clear from every cube in the project.
all_cubes.markdownDescription: When action='clear', clear from every cube in the project.

tools.name: mesh_primitive_op
tools.title: Mesh Primitive Op
tools.description: Mesh primitive creation (place_mesh/sphere/cylinder) collapsed into a single tool. The 'elements' shape changes per action — see action description for required fields. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy place_mesh / create_sphere / create_cylinder.

action.description: Primitive type. place_mesh: generic mesh from explicit vertices. sphere: spherical mesh from diameter/sides. cylinder: cylindrical mesh with optional caps.
action.markdownDescription: Primitive type. place_mesh: generic mesh from explicit vertices. sphere: spherical mesh from diameter/sides. cylinder: cylindrical mesh with optional caps.

elements.description: Per-primitive parameters. For place_mesh: meshSchema[]; sphere: { name, position, diameter, sides, rotation?, align_edges? }[]; cylinder: { name, position, height, diameter, sides, rotation?, capped? }[].
elements.markdownDescription: Per-primitive parameters. For place_mesh: meshSchema[]; sphere: { name, position, diameter, sides, rotation?, align_edges? }[]; cylinder: { name, position, height, diameter, sides, rotation?, capped? }[].

texture.description: Texture ID or name to apply.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture ID or name to apply.

group.description: Group/bone to which the primitives belong.
group.markdownDescription: Group/bone to which the primitives belong.

tools.name: mesh_edit_op
tools.title: Mesh Edit Op
tools.description: Mesh-editing operations (extrude/subdivide/select_elements/move_vertices/delete_elements/merge_vertices/create_face/knife) collapsed into a single tool. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy extrude_mesh / subdivide_mesh / select_mesh_elements / move_mesh_vertices / delete_mesh_elements / merge_mesh_vertices / create_mesh_face / knife_tool.

action.description: Mesh editing operation. extrude/subdivide/delete_elements/knife use Blockbench's built-in mesh tools; the rest mutate vertices/faces directly.
action.markdownDescription: Mesh editing operation. extrude/subdivide/delete_elements/knife use Blockbench's built-in mesh tools; the rest mutate vertices/faces directly.

mesh_id.description: Mesh uuid or name. Required for select_elements/merge_vertices/knife. Optional for the others (defaults to the selected mesh).
mesh_id.markdownDescription: Mesh uuid or name. Required for select_elements/merge_vertices/knife. Optional for the others (defaults to the selected mesh).

mode.description: extrude: extrusion mode ('faces' etc., kept as label). select_elements: 'vertex'|'edge'|'face'. delete_elements: 'vertex'|'edge'|'face' (label).
mode.markdownDescription: extrude: extrusion mode ('faces' etc., kept as label). select_elements: 'vertex'|'edge'|'face'. delete_elements: 'vertex'|'edge'|'face' (label).

elements.description: select_elements: list of vertex keys, face keys, or edge keys ('vkeyA-vkeyB'). Empty = select all of the chosen mode.
elements.markdownDescription: select_elements: list of vertex keys, face keys, or edge keys ('vkeyA-vkeyB'). Empty = select all of the chosen mode.

selection_action.description: select_elements: how to combine with existing selection. Defaults to 'select' (clears then sets).
selection_action.markdownDescription: select_elements: how to combine with existing selection. Defaults to 'select' (clears then sets).

vertices.description: move_vertices: vertex keys to move (defaults to currently selected vertices). create_face: vertex keys to use as the face's corners (in order).
vertices.markdownDescription: move_vertices: vertex keys to move (defaults to currently selected vertices). create_face: vertex keys to use as the face's corners (in order).

keep_vertices.description: delete_elements: keep vertices when deleting faces/edges.
keep_vertices.markdownDescription: delete_elements: keep vertices when deleting faces/edges.

selected_only.description: merge_vertices: limit merge candidates to the current selection.
selected_only.markdownDescription: merge_vertices: limit merge candidates to the current selection.

texture.description: create_face: texture uuid/name/id to apply to the new face.
texture.markdownDescription: create_face: texture uuid/name/id to apply to the new face.

points.description: knife: ordered list of cut points (3D position + optional face uuid).
points.markdownDescription: knife: ordered list of cut points (3D position + optional face uuid).

tools.name: brush_preset_op
tools.title: Brush Preset Op
tools.description: Brush preset operations (create/load) collapsed into a single tool. Presets are persisted via StateMemory.brush_presets. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy create_brush_preset / load_brush_preset.

action.description: Operation. create: save a new brush preset with the given settings. load: activate an existing preset by name.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create: save a new brush preset with the given settings. load: activate an existing preset by name.

name.description: Preset name. Required for action='create' (saved as the preset's id) and action='load' (look up by this name).
name.markdownDescription: Preset name. Required for action='create' (saved as the preset's id) and action='load' (look up by this name).

tools.name: paint_tool_op
tools.title: Paint Tool Op
tools.description: Paint operations (fill/shape/gradient/color_pick/copy_brush/eraser/settings/paint_with_brush/texture_selection/texture_layer) collapsed into a single tool. Replaces legacy paint_fill_tool / draw_shape_tool / gradient_tool / color_picker_tool / copy_brush_tool / eraser_tool / paint_settings / paint_with_brush / texture_selection / texture_layer_management. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }.

action.description: Paint operation. Most ops require texture_id (defaults to the active texture). Coordinates are in texture-space pixels unless noted.
action.markdownDescription: Paint operation. Most ops require texture_id (defaults to the active texture). Coordinates are in texture-space pixels unless noted.

texture_id.description: Texture uuid/name/id. Defaults to the currently active texture if omitted.
texture_id.markdownDescription: Texture uuid/name/id. Defaults to the currently active texture if omitted.

opacity.description: 0-100 for fill/shape/gradient/copy_brush/eraser; 0-100 layer opacity for texture_layer set_opacity.
opacity.markdownDescription: 0-100 for fill/shape/gradient/copy_brush/eraser; 0-100 layer opacity for texture_layer set_opacity.

set_as_secondary.description: color_pick: store the picked color as the secondary color.
set_as_secondary.markdownDescription: color_pick: store the picked color as the secondary color.

pick_opacity.description: color_pick: also pick opacity from the texture alpha.
pick_opacity.markdownDescription: color_pick: also pick opacity from the texture alpha.

coordinates.markdownDescription: Array of points (eraser / paint_with_brush) or rectangle coords (texture_selection select_rectangle / select_ellipse).

connect_strokes.description: eraser / paint_with_brush: continue the previous stroke instead of starting a new one.

layer_name.description: texture_layer: name for create_layer or rename_layer.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new project with the given name and project type.

format.description: Project format ID from Blockbench's Formats registry.
format.markdownDescription: Project format ID from Blockbench's Formats registry.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.title: Get Project Info
tools.description: Returns read-only project orientation: format id and display name, project name/UUID, texture resolution (texture_width/height), element counts, and a summary of top-level groups. Prefer this over `risky_eval` for first-look inspection — no JavaScript execution required.

tools.name: material_op
tools.title: Material Op
tools.description: PBR material operations (create_pbr/configure/assign_channel/save_config) collapsed into a single tool. Materials are texture groups with is_material=true. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy create_pbr_material / configure_material / assign_texture_channel / save_material_config. Use inspect(target='materials') to list.

action.description: Operation. create_pbr: new PBR material (texture group is_material=true). configure: mutate channel assignments / uniform values. assign_channel: bind one texture to a PBR channel. save_config: write texture_set.json to disk (Bedrock).
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create_pbr: new PBR material (texture group is_material=true). configure: mutate channel assignments / uniform values. assign_channel: bind one texture to a PBR channel. save_config: write texture_set.json to disk (Bedrock).

material.description: Material name or UUID. Required for action='configure'/'assign_channel'/'save_config'.
material.markdownDescription: Material name or UUID. Required for action='configure'/'assign_channel'/'save_config'.

texture.description: Texture name or UUID to assign. Required for action='assign_channel'.
texture.markdownDescription: Texture name or UUID to assign. Required for action='assign_channel'.

color_texture.description: Texture for color channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.
color_texture.markdownDescription: Texture for color channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.

normal_texture.description: Texture for normal channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.
normal_texture.markdownDescription: Texture for normal channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.

height_texture.description: Texture for height channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.
height_texture.markdownDescription: Texture for height channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.

mer_texture.description: Texture for MER channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.
mer_texture.markdownDescription: Texture for MER channel. Pass 'none' in configure to unbind.

tools.name: texture_op
tools.title: Texture Op
tools.description: Texture operations (create/apply/add_group/import_set/activate) collapsed into a single tool. Replaces legacy create_texture / apply_texture / add_texture_group / import_texture_set / activate_texture. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. For listing/reading textures use inspect(target='textures').

action.description: Operation. create: new texture (data URL / file path / fill_color). apply: apply a texture to a cube/mesh/group's faces. add_group: create a texture group (optionally with members). import_set: import a *.texture_set.json file. activate: select an existing texture so paint tools target it.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. create: new texture (data URL / file path / fill_color). apply: apply a texture to a cube/mesh/group's faces. add_group: create a texture group (optionally with members). import_set: import a *.texture_set.json file. activate: select an existing texture so paint tools target it.

name.description: Texture name (create) or group name (add_group). Required for create/add_group.
name.markdownDescription: Texture name (create) or group name (add_group). Required for create/add_group.

width.description: Texture width in px (create). Defaults to 16.
width.markdownDescription: Texture width in px (create). Defaults to 16.

height.description: Texture height in px (create). Defaults to 16.
height.markdownDescription: Texture height in px (create). Defaults to 16.

data.description: Source for create: data: URL ('data:image/png;base64,...') or file path. Omit to start blank.
data.markdownDescription: Source for create: data: URL ('data:image/png;base64,...') or file path. Omit to start blank.

fill_color.description: Fill color for create when no data is given. Hex string or [r, g, b, a?].
fill_color.markdownDescription: Fill color for create when no data is given. Hex string or [r, g, b, a?].

group.description: Existing texture group uuid/name to attach the new texture to (create).
group.markdownDescription: Existing texture group uuid/name to attach the new texture to (create).

id.description: Target element uuid/name for action='apply' (cube/mesh/group). Use inspect(target='outline') to discover.
id.markdownDescription: Target element uuid/name for action='apply' (cube/mesh/group). Use inspect(target='outline') to discover.

applyTo.description: apply: 'all' = every face, 'blank' = untextured only, 'none' = clear. Defaults to 'blank'.
applyTo.markdownDescription: apply: 'all' = every face, 'blank' = untextured only, 'none' = clear. Defaults to 'blank'.

texture.description: Texture uuid/name/id. Required for activate. Optional for apply (defaults to the project's default texture).
texture.markdownDescription: Texture uuid/name/id. Required for activate. Optional for apply (defaults to the project's default texture).

textures.description: Texture uuids/names to include in the new group (add_group).
textures.markdownDescription: Texture uuids/names to include in the new group (add_group).

is_material.description: Whether the new group is a material group (add_group). Defaults to false.
is_material.markdownDescription: Whether the new group is a material group (add_group). Defaults to false.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to a *.texture_set.json file (import_set).
path.markdownDescription: Absolute filesystem path to a *.texture_set.json file (import_set).

tools.name: trigger_action
tools.title: Trigger Action
tools.description: Triggers an action in the Blockbench editor.

action.description: Action ID from Blockbench's BarItems registry.
action.markdownDescription: Action ID from Blockbench's BarItems registry.

confirmDialog.description: Whether or not to automatically confirm any dialogs that appear as a result of the action.
confirmDialog.markdownDescription: Whether or not to automatically confirm any dialogs that appear as a result of the action.

tools.name: emulate_clicks
tools.title: Emulate Clicks
tools.description: Emulates clicks on the given interface elements.

duration.description: Duration of the drag in milliseconds.
duration.markdownDescription: Duration of the drag in milliseconds.

drag.description: Drag options. If set, will perform a drag from position to 'to'.
drag.markdownDescription: Drag options. If set, will perform a drag from position to 'to'.

tools.name: fill_dialog
tools.title: Fill Dialog
tools.description: Fills the dialog with the given values.

values.description: Stringified form of values to fill the dialog with.
values.markdownDescription: Stringified form of values to fill the dialog with.

confirm.description: Whether to confirm or cancel the dialog after filling it. True to confirm, false to cancel.
confirm.markdownDescription: Whether to confirm or cancel the dialog after filling it. True to confirm, false to cancel.

tools.name: risky_eval
tools.title: Eval
tools.description: Evaluates the given JavaScript expression inside Blockbench and returns the result. Use read_only=true for observation-only code so the Undo stack is not polluted.

code.description: JavaScript code to evaluate inside Blockbench. The last expression's value is returned; if it is a Promise it is awaited. Use an async IIFE — `(async () => { ... })()` — for async code; top-level `await` is not supported in this eval context (script, not module).
code.markdownDescription: JavaScript code to evaluate inside Blockbench. The last expression's value is returned; if it is a Promise it is awaited. Use an async IIFE — `(async () => { ... })()` — for async code; top-level `await` is not supported in this eval context (script, not module).

read_only.description: If true, skip Undo.initEdit/finishEdit so no Undo history entry is created. Use this when the code only reads state.
read_only.markdownDescription: If true, skip Undo.initEdit/finishEdit so no Undo history entry is created. Use this when the code only reads state.

truncate_limit.description: Override the default truncate limit (8192 chars). Larger values risk bloating caller context.
truncate_limit.markdownDescription: Override the default truncate limit (8192 chars). Larger values risk bloating caller context.

tools.name: mesh_uv_op
tools.title: Mesh UV Op
tools.description: Mesh UV operations (set/auto/rotate) collapsed into a single tool. set writes explicit UV for one face; auto applies project/unwrap/cylinder/sphere mapping; rotate rotates UV by 90/180/270 degrees. Returns { ok, data, error?, meta? }. Replaces legacy set_mesh_uv / auto_uv_mesh / rotate_mesh_uv.

action.description: Operation. set: explicit per-vertex UV for one face. auto: project/unwrap/cylinder/sphere mapping. rotate: 90/180/270 degree rotation.
action.markdownDescription: Operation. set: explicit per-vertex UV for one face. auto: project/unwrap/cylinder/sphere mapping. rotate: 90/180/270 degree rotation.

mesh_id.description: Mesh UUID or name. Required for action='set'. For auto/rotate, defaults to first selected mesh.
mesh_id.markdownDescription: Mesh UUID or name. Required for action='set'. For auto/rotate, defaults to first selected mesh.

uv_mapping.description: Map of vertex_key -> [u, v]. Required for action='set'.
uv_mapping.markdownDescription: Map of vertex_key -> [u, v]. Required for action='set'.

mode.description: UV mapping mode for action='auto'. Defaults to 'project' (matches legacy auto_uv_mesh).
mode.markdownDescription: UV mapping mode for action='auto'. Defaults to 'project' (matches legacy auto_uv_mesh).

angle.description: Rotation angle for action='rotate'. Defaults to '90' (matches legacy rotate_mesh_uv).
angle.markdownDescription: Rotation angle for action='rotate'. Defaults to '90' (matches legacy rotate_mesh_uv).

faces.description: Specific face keys for auto/rotate. Defaults to currently selected faces.
faces.markdownDescription: Specific face keys for auto/rotate. Defaults to currently selected faces.

resources.name: projects
resources.title: Blockbench Projects
resources.description: Returns information about available projects. List URIs use the slugified project name (e.g. `projects://my-character`) when unique, or `projects://<slug>~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: nodes
resources.title: Blockbench Nodes
resources.description: Returns the current 3D nodes in the editor. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `nodes://head`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: textures
resources.title: Blockbench Textures
resources.description: Returns information about textures. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `textures://skin`) when unique, with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, slug, or short numeric texture id.

resources.name: reference_models
resources.title: Reference Models
resources.description: Returns reference models in the current project. Requires the Reference Models plugin. List URIs use slugified names (e.g. `reference_models://turntable`) with `~<uuid-prefix>` on collision. Reads accept UUID, exact name, or slug.

resources.name: validator-status
resources.title: Validator Status
resources.description: Returns the current validation status including error/warning counts and a summary of all problems.

resources.name: validator-checks
resources.title: Validator Checks
resources.description: Returns information about registered validator checks. Use without an ID to list all checks, or provide a check ID to get details about a specific check.

resources.name: validator-warnings
resources.title: Validator Warnings
resources.description: Returns all current validation warnings with element references where available.

resources.name: validator-errors
resources.title: Validator Errors
resources.description: Returns all current validation errors with element references where available.
